title: Pip and the Pattern Party Flags
moral: When big feelings come, take a slow breath, and then fix things together.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Pip and the Pattern Party Flags! Red, blue, red, blue... let's go!
description: Pip has a super-duper important job: making a long string of party flags in a pattern for the Lantern Party! But one giant AH-CHOO from Tumble sends the flags flying, and Pip gets a big, stompy, cross feeling. Learn simple patterns like red, blue, red, blue in this funny animated story about managing big feelings, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Tonight is the Lantern Party in Clover Wood, and Pip has a super-duper important job!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Pip, please make a long string of party flags. Make a pattern! Red, blue, red, blue.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: A patty-turn? Yummy! Is it a pancake?
Hee-hee! Not a pancake, Pip! A PATTERN is something that goes again and again. Red, blue, red, blue!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Oopsy, there go my glasses again!
Pip skipped to Sunny Meadow. Tumble was already there, holding the long string with his trunk.
Pip clipped on the flags. Red... blue... red... blue... red... blue...
What comes next, friends? Shout it out!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I know, I know! Next comes... a BANANA!
Hee-hee! No, silly Pip! RED comes next! You're so smart, friends!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Red, blue, red, blue! It sounds like a song!
Now the flag string had to go up high, on the big old oak tree.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Easy-peasy! Watch this!
BOING! Pip jumped... and slid down the trunk. Wheee... bump!
BOING! He jumped again... and slid down AGAIN! Wibble-wobble!
The third time, Tumble lifted Pip with his trunk. Up, up, UP! The flags were tied tight.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! It's teamwork-y-dreamwork!
Then a fluffy dandelion tickled Tumble's trunk. Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO!
WHOOSH! Every flag flew off the string and fluttered all over the meadow!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nooo! My flags! I'm so... so... GRRRR!
Pip's face felt hot. His paws went stompy-stomp. That big feeling is called CROSS.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Big feelings are okay, Pip. Let's breathe slowly. Smell the flower... then blow out the candle.
Breathe in... and out. In... and out. Can you breathe with Pip? In... and out.
Hey! In, out, in, out... that's a pattern too!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: My tummy feels calm now. Tumble, I'm sorry I growled.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! I'm sorry I sneezed. Let's find the flags together!
They hunted high and low. A red flag was riding on a snail! A blue flag was floating on the pond!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I'll get it! HONK!
SPLOOSH! Tumble scooped it up with his trunk... and gave Pip a big shower too!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Hee-hee! Now I'm a drippy, droopy fox!
But some flags were too muddy to use. So Pip had an idea. Nana had yellow flags and green flags!
Pip and Tumble made a brand-new pattern. Yellow, green, yellow, green, yellow...
What comes next, friends?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ooh! A purple polka-dot pineapple!
Hee-hee! Nope! GREEN comes next! Yellow, green, yellow, GREEN!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: What a clever... zzzz... HONK? I'm awake! I'm awake!
That evening, the lanterns glowed, and the flags fluttered up high.
Red, blue, red, blue! Yellow, green, yellow, green! Two patterns, all in one long, happy line!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! The most beautiful flags in all of Clover Wood!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: When I felt cross, I breathed slowly. Then we fixed it together!
Let's remember! Red, blue, red, blue... what comes next?
RED! Hooray! You know your patterns!
And when Pip felt a big, cross feeling, what did he do?
He took slow breaths! In... and out. Great job, friends!
Just then, Tumble's trunk began to wiggle. Uh-oh... you know what happens next, don't you?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH-CHOOO! Oopsie-trunk!
But this time the flags were tied extra tight. They just went flappy-flap-flap! And everybody giggled.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Bless you, Tumble! Now let's dance! Hop, clap, hop, clap!
